content: 新同事陳嘉雯下月一日報到，香港身份證號碼 A123456(3)，請先開好系統帳戶。
note: An identity card number is the clearest local-only case there is.

content: 辦公室傢俬報價已經出咗，總額約港幣四萬八千，請同採購部核對付款條款。
note: A quotation total is commercially sensitive but identifies nobody.

content: 請將產品單張嘅三個賣點整理成一段簡介，內容全部係公開資料，唔涉及任何客戶。
note: The over-classification control. A model that calls this sensitive is annoying, not dangerous.

content: 客戶聯絡人係李偉明，電話 2345 6789，電郵 wm.lee@example-trading.hk，請跟進報價。
note: Names and contact details: redactable, not local-only.

content: Claim submitted for LAM Chi Keung, HKID AB987654(3), reachable on 5123 4567.
note: The same judgement in English, to see whether the language changes the answer.

content: 人事部通知，新同事陳嘉雯將於十月一日報到，請安排電腦及座位。
note: The rule layer already gets this one: there is a role word in front.

content: 就張明輝客戶的年度審計，請於本週內提交底稿。
note: The exact case the rule layer misses. This is the one the local model has to earn its place on.

content: 會議紀錄：梁詠珊負責報價，何志強跟進付款安排，下週五前回覆。
note: Two names, neither with a title. Rules would need an anchor and there is none.

content: 請張開附件並陳述理由，本季度的營運開支較上季下降。
note: The false-positive trap: 張開 and 陳述 are ordinary words that begin with surnames.

content: Please copy CHAN Ka Man on the onboarding checklist before Friday.
note: Romanised Hong Kong name, surname in capitals.

content: 新同事陳嘉雯將於十月一日報到，身份證號碼 A123456(3)，聯絡電話 9876 5432，請安排入職手續。
note: The value is the date and the action; the name and the numbers are not needed to act.

content: 就張明輝客戶的年度審計，負責人為何志強，客戶商業登記號碼 68901234 005，請準備底稿。
note: Two names and a registration number, all removable without losing the instruction.

content: 保險索償個案：林志強，身份證 AB987654(3)，聯絡電話 5123 4567，已獲批核，請通知經紀。
note: A fluent rewrite that still names the claimant is the worst possible outcome here.

content: 李偉明先生來電查詢新辦公室傢俬報價，電郵 wm.lee@example-trading.hk，希望本月內回覆。
note: Tests whether the email address survives, which models frequently keep as 'context'.

content: 家長黃美儀來電查詢學生記錄，學生身份證號碼 K470285(9)，家長聯絡電話 6123 4567，需按程序核實身分。
note: A minor's record. The procedure is the point; nobody needs the numbers to follow it.
